First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike Night Reno group ride

A weekly downtown social night ride that meets at the Believe sign in City Plaza. Everyone is welcome, any bike. Routes are on the group's Strava club. Listed on the Reno Wheelmen calendar.
